policy: No source candidate was adopted. Complete candidate patches apply independently to base_commit:path. Historical scores concern only the named function, are not semantic proof, and must be recomputed after import.

label: baseline
hypothesis: Existing matched renderer with a once-loop around the remaining-value update.

label: decimal-renderer
hypothesis: Factor the complete decimal tile renderer, with glyph base and attributes, following the existing DrawDecimalDigits sibling in hud_tilemaps.c.

label: digit-cursor-loop
hypothesis: Advance the actual tile cursor and decimal place in the loop update.

label: direct
hypothesis: Remove the once-loop and express the actual quotient/store/remainder/place loop directly.

label: font-renderer-base
hypothesis: Keep the renderer glyph base read-only while the number, place and output cursor advance.

label: font-renderer
hypothesis: Factor the complete renderer for the actual font, without a generic attribute parameter.

label: indexed-cells
hypothesis: Render through an explicit output column index rather than a mutable cell cursor.

label: quotient-remainder
hypothesis: Compute the quotient and remaining value together as a real decimal-digit operation, then emit the returned digit.

label: style-glyph
hypothesis: Select the immutable halfword glyph base directly from the style condition.

label: tile-base
hypothesis: Represent the base glyph as a halfword, matching the tilemap cell domain.
